# Routines — the families, the session, the sources, 2026-09-13

## Access and confidence

- **Sources read:** the framework article's plan two and its citation of
  the WHO guidelines (the guideline publication page, 25 November 2020,
  confirms the date; the figures are as the framework article states
  them and as the WHO fact sheet summarises them). McGill's *Back
  Mechanic* is cited from memory of the Big Three as commonly taught; no
  page was checked.
- **Judgement, not evidence:** the grouping into anti-movement, loaded and
  on-the-feet families; the five-block order; the one-minute rest between
  blocks; thirty minutes as the default. These are coaching conventions
  chosen for a living-room routine, and the article calls them decisions.

## The families

**Anti-movement (the trunk holds still).** Anti-extension: dead bug, front
plank, stir the pot, ab-wheel rollout, hollow hold. Anti-rotation: bird
dog, Pallof press, suitcase carry, renegade row, half-kneeling chop.
Anti-lateral-flexion: side plank (knees, then feet), suitcase carry,
Copenhagen plank. The McGill Big Three: curl-up with hands under the low
back, side plank, bird dog.

**Loaded, two hands:** goblet squat, kettlebell deadlift, two-hand swing,
floor press, two-dumbbell row, front-loaded carry. **One hand:** suitcase
deadlift and carry, single-arm row, half-kneeling overhead press,
single-arm floor press, one-hand swing, Turkish get-up.

**On the feet:** marching in place, jogging in place, skater hops, jumping
jacks (with a step-out version), step-ups, mountain climbers, shadow
boxing. **Mobility:** cat-camel to open and close.

## The session

Five blocks in order — warm-up, core, strength, aerobic, cool-down — with
a one-minute rest between blocks. Rests between exercises are avoided;
alternating the muscles loaded within a block is the rest. Durations are
per exercise in seconds; the rep count shown is derived from the move's
tempo (seconds per repetition) and is a ceiling.

| | 30 min | 45 min | 60 min |
|---|---|---|---|
| Warm-up | 3:00 | 4:00 | 5:00 |
| Core | 9:00 | 13:00 | 18:00 |
| Strength | 6:20 | 10:00 | 15:00 |
| Aerobic | 5:00 | 9:00 | 12:00 |
| Cool-down | 2:40 | 5:00 | 6:00 |
| Rests | 4:00 | 4:00 | 4:00 |

Each column sums to its length; the plans file is the authority.

## What is in the library, and what is not

Seventeen moves with clips (see `apps/owl-sessions/README.md`). Not in the
library, by choice or by failure: the McGill curl-up (generated as a
crunch twice), regressions from the knees, the Turkish get-up, jumping
jacks, mountain climbers, the floor press. A second version adds the
regressions first.

## Sources

- WHO, *Guidelines on physical activity and sedentary behaviour*, 25
  November 2020 — https://www.who.int/publications/i/item/9789240015128
- Stuart McGill, *Back Mechanic*, Backfitpro, 2015.
- *Planning to Age Well, with AI*, plan two — website/aging-well/ai-planning/index.md.
